Welcome to JING TV! 

Follow the weekly adventures of Meg and Rachel on weekly Jing TV episodes exploring the fascinating world of bodywork, business and beyond. Catch free Jing TV episodes for great tips on advanced massage techniques, how to get more clients and achieve the life you desire plus interviews with the movers and shakers in the massage biz. 

Jing Advanced Massage Training is a UK based, revolutionary postgraduate massage training organisation providing master CPD/CEU courses and ground-breaking degree level qualifications. 

To find out more about Jing advanced massage training, and to check out our hands on massage courses, please either give us a call on +441273 628 942, shoot us an email on info@jingmassage.com, or visit our website:

http://www.jingmassage.com/
